translation: Took place in posad Serock, 9 July 1890, 3 PM. Appeared personally Lejbka Poniaczyk[?], trader, 45, and Moszek Lewiner, trader, 70, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that this day at 5 AM died in posad Serock a child of female sex, without a name [inserted], aged six days, daughter of Szyja[?] Mortka Lewinson [surname inserted] and his wife Ruchla Leja nee Lewiner, residing in posad Serock. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by one witness.
